new_destinations.name: Zhenjiang
new_destinations.rank_reason: Mid-size Yangtze city with three famous hills and a historic ferry quarter; worth a detour beside Nanjing/Yangzhou, not a national highlight.
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page 'Zhenjiang' (See/Do listings: Jinshan Temple, Jiaoshan, Beigu Hill, Xijindu, Nanshan); travelchinaguide Zhenjiang attractions list.
new_destinations.span_reason: Ten spots within about 12 km of the centre (Vinegar Museum furthest); 30 km span gives 22.5 km.

standalone_near_destination_check.why_not_a_spot: Outside Zhenjiang city's urban bounds and span (48 km vs 22.5 km allowance); a mountain trip in Jurong reached via its own bases, not from the city centre.

notes: Zhenjiang is 60 km from Nanjing's centre, no overlap. Pearl S. Buck Former Residence (Zhenjiang) is also a review in Nanjing's list; Zhenjiang owns the kept one. Mount Mao owned here (Changzhou review list).
